rebuilt: 2026-10-20 gapfix: FY2025 Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, EBIT, Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax, Net Profit and EPS corrected to the reviewed statement. FY2024 Net Finance Costs corrected from 104 (gross finance costs) to 67 (net of finance income and net foreign exchange gains). Operating Expenses for FY2025 is 531, being selling, general and administrative 367 plus other operating expenses 156 plus the 8 share of losses from equity-accounted investees, so Gross Profit minus Operating Expenses equals the printed operating profit of 6. All figures are in US dollars, the reporting currency of the statement: revenue 5,420,000,000 and loss 177,000,000 for FY2025, revenue 5,458,000,000 and profit 33,000,000 for FY2024, EPS in dollars per share from the printed US cents.
